# 🐛 Bug Report

Thank you for taking the time to report a bug!  
Please fill out the details below so we can investigate effectively.

---

## 📌 Description

A clear and concise description of the problem.

> _Example: Localization values are not being seeded for new cultures._

---

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce

Please list the exact steps:

1.

## ✅ Expected Behavior

What *should* happen?

---

## ❌ Actual Behavior

What *actually* happens?

Please provide details:
